messages:
Tara (Product): Quick announcement 1: Hosted API Streaming + Tool-Call v1 is GA at 13:00 PT today. Stable schemas, improved chunk ordering, better error codes. Docs/migration: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/stream-tool-v1 :tada:

Lee (DevEx): Great. SDK helpers coming? Need short examples for customers.

Tara (Product): Yep  DevEx will publish SDK v1.2 with ToolCallV1 and stream iterators. Backcompat shim available but limited; 60-day deprecation for v0.

Asha (Eng): Rollout: 10% canary 30m -> 50% 1h -> 100% if green. Hotfix branch ready.

Marco (SRE): I'll add dashboards for streaming tail latency and schema reject rate; PD alert if rejects >3% for 5m.

deploy-bot: canary deployment started for stream-tool-v1 @10% (id: dpl_2026_03_21_1912345678)

Tara (Product): I'll post a customer-facing blurb to #release-notes and pin a migration checklist here. Thanks team!
